guideImpact.affectedSection: Navigating between GIS, the launcher, and API Request Audit
guideImpact.reason: The verified behavior requires users to return from GIS to the launcher with the browser Back control and then open API Request Audit. These cross-module navigation steps and the API Request Audit destination should be documented for end users.

guideUpdate.title: Navigate from GIS back to the launcher and into API Request Audit
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Navigating between GIS, the launcher, and API Request Audit
steps: Open GIS from the V4 launcher.
Use the browser Back control to return to the V4 launcher.
Open API Request Audit from its launcher card.
guideUpdate.reason: Document the verified navigation from GIS back to the launcher and onward to the API Request Audit dashboard.
